𝗙𝗢𝗥𝗚𝗘 𝗗𝗨𝗙𝗙𝗟𝗘 – 𝗙𝗼𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘁 𝗛𝗲𝗿𝗶𝘁𝗮𝗴𝗲 𝗘𝗱𝗶𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻
Some bags are made for a season. Others are made for a lifetime.
The 𝗙𝗼𝗿𝗴𝗲 𝗗𝘂𝗳𝗳𝗹𝗲 is handcrafted for those who appreciate 𝘁𝗶𝗺𝗲𝗹𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗱𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻, 𝗲𝘅𝗰𝗲𝗽𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗿𝗮𝗳𝘁𝘀𝗺𝗮𝗻𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽, and materials that become more beautiful with age. Wrapped in a rich 𝗕𝗿𝗶𝘁𝗶𝘀𝗵 𝗥𝗮𝗰𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗚𝗿𝗲𝗲𝗻 𝗽𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗶𝘂𝗺 𝗳𝘂𝗹𝗹-𝗴𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻 𝗼𝗶𝗹 𝗽𝘂𝗹𝗹-𝘂𝗽 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿 and accented with 𝗖𝗼𝗴𝗻𝗮𝗰 𝗕𝗿𝗼𝘄𝗻 leather details, this piece embodies understated luxury.
Every crease, every mark, and every journey adds character to the leather, creating a patina that is uniquely yours. Unlike synthetic materials, 𝗳𝘂𝗹𝗹-𝗴𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿 evolves with time, telling the story of every destination it has travelled.
Crafted using carefully selected 𝗽𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗶𝘂𝗺 𝗳𝘂𝗹𝗹-𝗴𝗿𝗮𝗶𝗻 𝗼𝗶𝗹 𝗽𝘂𝗹𝗹-𝘂𝗽 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝘁𝗵𝗲𝗿, the bag offers a smooth hand feel with a subtle natural sheen and depth of colour. The leather's pull-up finish creates gentle tonal variations whenever it bends, a hallmark of premium heritage leather found in luxury travel goods.
Every detail has been designed with longevity in mind. From the reinforced leather handles and precisely stitched panels to the 𝗽𝗿𝗲𝗺𝗶𝘂𝗺 𝗮𝗻𝘁𝗶𝗾𝘂𝗲 𝗯𝗿𝗮𝘀𝘀-𝗳𝗶𝗻𝗶𝘀𝗵 𝗵𝗮𝗿𝗱𝘄𝗮𝗿𝗲, each component is chosen for durability and elegance. The detachable, adjustable leather shoulder strap offers comfort during extended travel, while the 𝗵𝗲𝗮𝘃𝘆-𝗱𝘂𝘁𝘆 𝗺𝗲𝘁𝗮𝗹 𝘇𝗶𝗽𝗽𝗲𝗿 ensures years of dependable performance.
Measuring 𝟮𝟬 𝗶𝗻𝗰𝗵𝗲𝘀 in length, the 𝗙𝗼𝗿𝗴𝗲 𝗗𝘂𝗳𝗳𝗹𝗲 strikes the perfect balance between capacity and portability. It is spacious enough for weekend getaways, business trips, gym essentials, or daily travel.

The Heritage D-Pocket Rider
This premium asymmetrical double-rider is a tribute to mid-century motorcycle culture, meticulously crafted for the modern connoisseur. 

Combining heavy-duty protection with a high-end designer aesthetic, this jacket is built to be a lifelong companion.
products.long_description:
The Heritage D-Pocket Rider
This premium asymmetrical double-rider is a tribute to mid-century motorcycle culture, meticulously crafted for the modern connoisseur. Combining heavy-duty protection with a high-end designer aesthetic, this jacket is built to be a lifelong companion.

Design Highlights::::

Iconic D-Pocket: A signature curved "map pocket" on the left chest, offering a bold vintage look and practical storage.

Asymmetrical Cut: The offset main zipper creates a classic windproof double-layer across the chest for a sharp, aggressive silhouette.

Artisanal Back Panel: Features a high-relief leather appliqué "Master of the Deep" winged anchor design—crafted with layered leather patches for a 3D texture that never fades.

Bespoke Branding: Finished with a signature R.S. Leatherwork vegetable-tanned leather neck tag, ensuring an authentic, handcrafted feel.

Materials & Build :::

Premium Hide: Constructed from heavyweight, full-grain black leather with a natural sheen that develops a rich, personal patina over time.

Industrial Hardware: Outfitted with heavy-duty brass zippers, snap-down lapels, and functional epaulettes for a rugged, industrial finish.

Comfort & Fit: Includes an integrated waist belt and action-back gussets, providing maximum mobility and a tailored fit.

The Verdict: A perfect balance of raw street power and luxury craftsmanship, designed for those who demand a jacket as unique as their ride.

products.description:
Full-grain leather. Hand-burnished finish. Built to travel a lifetime.
Handcrafted in full-grain leather with precision hardware — luggage built like an heirloom, not an accessory.
Where heritage leathercraft meets modern travel — every Sovereign Trolley is hand-finished for a lifetime of journeys.
products.long_description:
The "𝗛𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗹𝗲 & 𝗛𝗲𝗿𝗶𝘁𝗮𝗴𝗲" Trolley is where heritage leathercraft meets modern travel. Every panel is cut from genuine full-grain hide, hand-burnished and finished to develop a deeper, richer patina with every journey. Structured yet lightweight, it carries the same standard of craftsmanship trusted by heritage leather houses — because we've made for them too. This isn't mass-produced luggage; it's a piece built to travel with you for decades.               



Hardware & Build:

Genuine Indian YKK zippers for a lifetime of smooth, silent operation
360° rotating precision wheels for effortless maneuverability
Reinforced corner guards and stitched leather piping for structural durability
Telescopic aluminium trolley handle, tested for repeated extension
Brass-toned hardware, tarnish-resistant finish

Compartments:

Spacious main compartment with compression straps to secure contents
Dedicated front zip pocket for documents, chargers, and essentials
Soft interior lining to protect garments and valuables

Care Instructions:

Wipe with a soft, dry cloth after each use
Condition with leather balm every 3–4 months to preserve suppleness
Avoid prolonged direct sunlight and moisture exposure
Store upright in breathable fabric when not in use

Available Sizes: 20"· 22" · 24" · 28"

All sizes are in Inches : Height Calculated from wheels to top handle.

Every piece can be custom made to order — choice of leather, lining, and hardware finish.

📩 Connect with us on WhatsApp or Instagram to begin your bespoke order.
